name: The Quarantine Queue
summary: Three sick villagers wait outside the apothecary, and Morgan has beds for one at a time.

stages.journal: Morgan can treat the sick only one at a time, and the three in the queue each think they should be first: Haldor Vane, Ottilie Reed and Pim Fenwick.
objectives: Talk to Haldor, Ottilie and Pim
stages.hint: Talk to the three in the queue outside the apothecary, then tell Morgan the order.

stages.journal: The queue was settled and Morgan treated them in the order we gave.
We left the queue to sort itself out. Mourning ribbons went up on a door in the Round.
